items.title: Google Discover Core Update Hits Local Publishers' National Reach
items.summary: Google's Discover core update reduced national reach for local publishers, with sites like Syracuse.com and cbs6albany.com losing over 36% of article placements and up to 80% of audience scores, primarily from out-of-state feeds such as Florida and California, while retaining home-state visibility. Major publishers including Yahoo (down 50% in placements and 62% in audience score), Fox properties (over 40% drop), and Forbes (21% placements and 67% audience loss) also experienced significant declines in Discover visibility. The update prioritized locally relevant content, suggesting local publishers should focus on regional targeting.

items.title: AI Search Engines Rarely Cite Syndicated News Or Press Releases
items.summary: AI search engines, such as ChatGPT, Google AI Mode, Google AI Overviews, and Google Gemini, rarely cite syndicated news or press releases, with syndicated press releases accounting for only 0.32% of news citations and 0.04% of the total dataset from 4 million citations analyzed in a BuzzStream report. In contrast, original editorial content dominates at 81% of news citations, while owned newsroom content on company domains performs better. This trend implies that for SEO and content marketing, focusing on earning original coverage through digital PR and maintaining owned newsrooms is more effective than relying on syndicated distribution for AI visibility.

items.title: Google Provides More Details on Googlebot Crawl Limits
items.summary: Google has shared more details on Googlebot crawl limits, which are designed to protect infrastructure and are flexible, allowing overrides such as reducing the default 15 megabyte limit to 2 megabytes for Google Search or increasing it for PDFs up to 64 megabytes. These limits help manage processing overhead from large documents and prevent overwhelming Google's systems, with different crawlers applying varied settings based on needs like fast indexing. For SEO relevance, excessively large files can hinder crawling efficiency, so optimizing content size ensures better indexing and avoids crawl budget waste.

items.title: SEO vs AEO vs GEO: The Evolution Explained
items.summary: As an SEO pro, SEO is still king for traditional search with keywords, content, backlinks; AEO for direct answers in AI chatbots and voice assistants; GEO for visibility in AI-generated summaries like ChatGPT or Google AI Overviews via authority, uniqueness, structured data. The difference: SEO for lists, AEO for answers, GEO for AI remixes. Smart brands run all three parallel.

items.title: New Features on Google Discover Publisher Profile Pages
items.summary: Big changes for Google Discover publisher profiles: large header images for some US sites, 'featured posts' block to highlight posts, social media videos, articles; new 'Links' block for site categories. Some profiles in preparation awaiting header images. Monitoring tool tracks rollout.

items.title: GEO + AEO + Agentic SEO: Strategy to Win AI Search Citations
items.summary: 47% of Google searches now show AI answers first; GEO + AEO + Agentic SEO is key to getting cited in them. Shares a full 90-day strategy guide. Essential for SEO in 2026.

items.title: Grammarly Accused of Impersonating Journalists in AI Editing Feature
items.summary: Tech journalist Ray Wong calls out Grammarly for using his name and Gizmodo affiliation in its 'Expert Review' AI feature without permission or endorsement, scraping his career's work to simulate expert writing suggestions. He describes it as identity theft and criticizes the company's disclaimer as insufficient. The post highlights growing concerns over AI misuse in editing and writing tools.

items.title: Official BookTok Chart Set to Launch in the UK
items.summary: Publishing Well shares news of an official BookTok chart launching in the UK, combining retail sales data with TikTok engagement for a monthly Top 20. Compiled by NielsenIQ BookData and Media Control, it follows a successful German version. This formalizes BookTok's influence on book sales and trends.

items.title: AI Supercharges Book Publishing Scams Targeting Self-Published Authors
items.summary: Interactive Journalism highlights a Guardian story on fraudsters using AI to create personalized scam solicitations for self-published authors, promising publishing deals and marketing. Examples include authors losing thousands to fake services. The boom in self-publishing exacerbates vulnerability to these AI-enhanced swindles.

items.title: Oscars 2026: Has Hollywood's “wokeism” run its course?
items.summary: The applause once given to celebrity activism at the Oscars has shifted to exhaustion and major backlash. Audiences express irritation with preachy speeches and political lectures. The article questions if Hollywood's woke era is ending.

items.title: Jean Smart Blasted for Getting Teary-Eyed While 'Spewing Woke Propaganda' at Golden Globes
items.summary: Jean Smart faced backlash for her teary-eyed political comments on the 2026 Golden Globes red carpet. Critics accused her of promoting woke views inappropriately. The reaction underscores audience frustration with celebrity activism.

items.title: Can the Oscars leave the woke era behind?
items.summary: The Academy's new casting award is viewed as a rebuke to Hollywood's DEI agenda and woke quotas. This comes amid growing audience backlash to preachy content. It signals potential change in entertainment awards.

items.title: Liberal Women Roasted at Non-Woke Comedy Show
items.summary: A video captures young liberal women attending a non-woke comedy show where they are hilariously roasted by the comedian. The audience cheers enthusiastically. The clip went viral illustrating demand for anti-preachy humor.

items.title: Audience Calls to Boycott Oscars Over Woke Virtue-Signaling
items.summary: Users urge boycotting the Oscars citing endless lectures on Trump, America, and activist projects during speeches. Hollywood accused of injecting LGBTQ themes into kids' films. Reflects broad audience disillusionment with preachy entertainment.

items.title: Jennifer Welch's Rant at GLAAD Awards: 'Fck ICE! Fck Donald Trump!'
items.summary: Jennifer Welch delivers unhinged speech at GLAAD Awards cursing ICE and Trump, met with cheers from audience. Posted as example of celebrity detachment. Sparks online reactions to preachy award show moments.

items.title: Every Launches AI-Native Back Office Agents for Startups and Small Businesses
items.summary: Every has launched AI agents such as the AI CFO, AI Bookkeeper, and AI CHRO to automate back-office tasks for startups and small businesses. These tools handle finance, bookkeeping, and HR functions efficiently. This new suite empowers founders to focus on growth rather than admin work.

items.title: Polsia Launches as Autonomous AI Business Builder for Solo Founders
items.summary: Polsia is a groundbreaking AI platform that autonomously builds and runs businesses from a simple idea or 'surprise me' prompt, handling servers, payments, landing pages, ads, and daily optimizations via an AI CEO. It has already powered over 2,000 companies with $1.8M in cash flows. This tool dramatically lowers barriers for small business creation and operation.

items.title: Slow Real-World AI Adoption Among Small Businesses Despite Hype
items.summary: Entrepreneur Syed Balkhi reveals that AI use in small businesses is mostly limited to search and basic content generation, with agentic AI and vibe coding largely failing in practice due to manual iterations and debugging issues. He emphasizes the need for human oversight and notes adoption is still very early. This highlights the actual impact and challenges for SMBs.
